pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[EspManager\] Updating ESP tracked install status from (?<from>\w+) to (?<to>\w+) for application {GUID}
description: Captures ESP tracked install status transitions (e.g., InProgress to Installed) for a specific app. No trailing anchor: IME 1.97 (Dec 2025) appends ' with name: <appName>.' after the GUID (EspManager.cs), which broke the previous '\.' suffix. 'from' can be the literal string 'null' on first tracking.
